mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subtask_images (tenant_id, subtask_id, filename, content_type, data, created_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{i.subtaskId}, #{i.filename}, #{i.contentType}, #{i.data}, #{i.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, subtask_id, filename, content_type, created_at FROM subtask_images WHERE subtask_id = #{subtaskId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id ASC
